expectations.text: Initial report: within 4 hours of classification AND no later than 24 hours from awareness
expectations.evidence: 'Within 4 hours of classification as major, and no later than 24 hours from the entity becoming aware'

expectations.text: Intermediate report: within 72 hours from submission of the initial notification
expectations.evidence: 'Within 72 hours from submission of the initial notification'

expectations.text: Final report: no later than one month from the (latest) intermediate report
expectations.evidence: 'No later than 1 month from the (latest) intermediate report'

expectations.text: States the weekend/bank-holiday relief: next working day by noon (with the carve-out for significant credit institutions)
expectations.evidence: 'submission may be made by noon of the next working day' and 'relief is disapplied for the initial and intermediate reports of significant credit institutions'

expectations.text: Cites CDR (EU) 2025/301 as the source of the time limits
